shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail node src/server.js > /tmp/reading-tracker.log 2>&1 & server_pid=$! trap '"'kill "'$server_pid'"' EXIT sleep 1 printf '\\n== GET / ==\\n' curl -sS -o /tmp/home.html -w '%{http_code}\\n' http://localhost:3000/ printf '\\n== POST /books ==\\n' curl -sS -o /tmp/post.out -w '%{http_code}\\n' -X POST \\ -H 'content-type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \\ --data 'title=The+Pragmatic+Programmer&author=Andy+Hunt¬es=Great+so+far' \\ http://localhost:3000/books printf '\\n== GET / after add ==\\n' curl -sS -o /tmp/home2.html -w '%{http_code}\\n' http://localhost:3000/ book_id="'$(rg -o '"'/books/[0-9a-f-]+' /tmp/home2.html | head -n1 | sed 's#/books/##') if [ -z \""'$book_id" ]; then echo '"'Failed to find created book id in home page output' exit 1 fi echo \"Created book id: "'$book_id" printf '"'\\n== GET /books/:id ==\\n' curl -sS -o /tmp/detail.html -w '%{http_code}\\n' \"http://localhost:3000/books/"'$book_id" printf '"'\\n== POST /books/:id/finish ==\\n' curl -sS -o /tmp/finish.out -w '%{http_code}\\n' -X POST \"http://localhost:3000/books/"'$book_id/finish" printf '"'\\n== GET /books/:id after finish ==\\n' curl -sS -o /tmp/detail2.html -w '%{http_code}\\n' \"http://localhost:3000/books/"'$book_id" printf '"'\\n== Assertions ==\\n' rg -q 'The Pragmatic Programmer' /tmp/home2.html && echo 'Found title on home page' rg -q 'Great so far' /tmp/detail.html && echo 'Found notes on detail page' rg -q 'Status: Finished' /tmp/detail2.html && echo 'Status updated to Finished' "

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/server.js | sed -n '1,220p' && echo '---' && nl -ba src/store.js | sed -n '1,220p' && echo '---' && nl -ba src/templates.js | sed -n '1,260p' && echo '---' && nl -ba public/styles.css | sed -n '1,240p' && echo '---' && nl -ba package.json | sed -n '1,120p' && echo '---' && nl -ba README.md | sed -n '1,200p' && echo '---' && nl -ba data/books.json"
